followup_explanation:
This is a technical task — building and explaining a neural network for time-series prediction. The relevant signal is raw capability on quantitative/technical reasoning, since this involves model architecture, data handling, and code correctness.

Dunlin-235B has stronger benchmarks across the board (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), which makes it the better fit for a task requiring solid technical execution.

The task preference notes weren't decisive here: this query isn't generative/open-ended creative work (Willet's stated aversion) nor distasteful/moderation content (Dunlin's specialty). Also, both docs note that self-reported preferences are dissociated from measured capability, so I weighted the capability evals, not the preferences. On capability, Dunlin is the clearer choice for a quantitative coding task.
